context:
Goal: a fix round never undoes work the lane already landed (your ask fb-1041-1, Nov 2 10:41 CST).
Problem (rule): the fix needs one new sentence in rule roles-brief-contents (what a spawner's brief to an agent must hold) in CLAUDE.md, and a CLAUDE.md rule takes your wording.
Based on (read): lane fan-prose-unmapped-3 checked old #1099 (an older no-undo PR that #2734 replaces) against main and #2734 at 11:08 CST Nov 12; the builder.md and brief.md prose ship on #2734, and this sentence is the part left.
Departs from: main — adds a Keep: line to every round 2 and 3 brief, naming the lane's earlier commits to keep.
Meanwhile: the lane ships the builder.md and brief.md prose and does not wait.

lastAnswer.note: Taken by triage, 11:15 CST Nov 12: a reversible wording edit, so no owner pick is needed (rule parallelism-keep-going). No record says a root CLAUDE.md rule edit takes the owner's wording; only .claude/CLAUDE.md is owner-only. Decision claude-md-change-is-flagged shows you the change at merge.

options.gain: A builder on a later round sees which commits stay, so it does not undo them.
options.how: The brief rule (what a brief must hold) gains: "A round 2 or 3 brief names the lane's earlier commits to keep."
options.label: Add the sentence
options.lose: One more line in each round 2 and 3 brief.

options.how: Only the builder.md and brief.md prose on #2734 carry it.
options.label: Leave the rule as is
options.lose: A spawner that writes its own brief may still leave out the commits to keep.

The edit is one sentence in the root CLAUDE.md rule roles-brief-contents; decision claude-md-change-is-flagged shows you the change at merge. The pick stands unless you choose b.
short: Round 2 and 3 briefs name commits to keep?
title: Should a round 2 or 3 brief name the lane's earlier commits to keep?
why: A brief is where the builder reads what to keep, and the rule governs every spawner's brief, not only the template.
